title: Decision: Switching LLM Provider from OpenAI to Anthropic
goals: ensure reliable AI capabilities, optimize cost efficiency, maintain model performance, and reduce vendor dependency risks

options.title: Stay with OpenAI
options.description: Continue using GPT-4 and GPT-3.5-turbo models with current implementation and pricing structure

options.title: Switch to Anthropic
options.description: Migrate to Claude 3 family of models (Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku) with new implementation
